transcript.text: Hi everyone. The batch-inference service has passed staging validation on T4 GPUs, sustaining four concurrent inference jobs without failure, and it's ready for its first production workload. Before I can record the production operating plan, the launch-readiness checklist requires platform, machine-learning, finance, and privacy representatives to review capacity, cost, and data-handling settings. I'd like to get that review going now. One thing to flag upfront: our existing committed-use GPU credits can be applied to eligible A10G capacity provisioned in eu-west-1, so that may factor into our capacity and cost discussion. Who'd like to start?

This result has not yet been added to the launch ticket, so the staging validation at four concurrent jobs on T4s doesn't reflect the actual production requirement.
